model.underlying: GloVe 6B 300d (Stanford NLP), trained on Wikipedia 2014 + Gigaword 5
model.license: PDDL v1.0 (public domain) for the pretrained vectors
model.method: word-level lookup — no tokenisation, no pooling, no inference
model.normalization: L2 to unit length, applied by this script; GloVe ships un-normalised

float32.location: src/labs/embedding-universe/fixtures/ — test reference, never shipped or fetched
float32.layout: wordCount x dimensions, little-endian f32, vocabulary order

int16.location: public/labs/embedding-universe/ — the only vector asset the browser fetches
int16.layout: wordCount x dimensions little-endian i16, then wordCount little-endian f32 scales
int16.scheme: symmetric per-vector: q = round(v / s) clamped to +/-32767, s = max|v| / 32767
int16.note: scales are stored for completeness but are not needed to decode: the decoder re-normalises, and L2(s*q) === L2(q) for s > 0
